label: linino dogUSB
description:
A type USB connector.
Fully compliant with USB Hub specification version 2.0 and is also backward compatible with
USB Hub specification 1.1.
Supports automatic switching between bus-power and self-power modes built-in USB 2.0 transceiver.
uSD connector with card reader.
Supports multiple sectors transfer optimize performance.
Supports port-to-slot and read/write operation.
